title: A crew member as a document v1 (crew.character.v1)
about: A character made on the creation page (GitHub #13462; docs/metaverse/2026-11-13-character-creation.md): a name, the body's record of clamped numbers, the face and hair choices, and one piece of the wardrobe a slot. The creation page writes it, keeps it in the browser and takes one from its address or from a message; a game reads it. A document with a value out of range, an unknown key, a key twice or a part missing is refused with a reason in words, never clamped.
